=== adrp to a label on the same page
start:
        adrp    x0, here
        add     x0, x0, :lo12:here
here:
        ret

=== adrp to a later page in the same section
        adrp    x0, far
        add     x0, x0, :lo12:far
        ret
        .space  0x2000 - 12
        nop
far:
        ret

=== adrp back to an earlier page
back:
        ret
        .space  0x3000
        adrp    x1, back
        add     x1, x1, :lo12:back

=== adrp from a page boundary @ 0x400ff8
        nop
        adrp    x0, next
        adrp    x1, next
        add     x1, x1, :lo12:next
next:
        ret

=== adrp into another section
        .text
        adrp    x0, msg
        add     x0, x0, :lo12:msg
        ldrb    w1, [x0, :lo12:msg]
        ret
        .data
        .space  0x1234
msg:    .ascii  "hi"

=== scaled :lo12: loads into another section
        .text
        adrp    x0, vars
        ldr     x1, [x0, :lo12:vars]
        ldr     w2, [x0, :lo12:vars + 8]
        ldrh    w3, [x0, :lo12:vars + 12]
        ldr     q4, [x0, :lo12:vars + 16]
        str     x5, [x0, :lo12:vars]
        ret
        .data
        .p2align 4
        .space  0xff0
vars:   .quad   1, 2, 3, 4

=== adrp with an addend
        .text
        adrp    x0, table + 0x1000
        add     x0, x0, :lo12:table + 0x1000
        adrp    x1, table - 4
        add     x1, x1, :lo12:table - 4
        ret
        .data
table:  .quad   0

=== adr and literal loads into another section
        .text
        adr     x0, value
        ldr     x1, value
        ldr     w2, value
        b       .
        .data
value:  .quad   0x1122334455667788

=== branches and data across sections
        .text
entry:
        bl      helper
        b       helper
        .section .text.helper, "ax"
helper:
        ret
        .data
        .quad   entry
        .4byte  helper - .
        .8byte  entry - .

=== executable sections start on an instruction boundary
        .text
        .byte   1
        .section .text.b,"ax"
        .byte   2
        .data
        .byte   3
